sentences.quote: In 1999, she joined Alcatel. In 2008, she was appointed to the Alcatel-Lucent's Executive Committee as Sales Director for France and promoted in 2011 as Director of Human Resources and Transformation.
sentences.text: A graduate of Ecole Polytechnique and Ecole Nationale des Ponts et Chaussees, she began her career at the Boston Consulting Group before joining Alcatel in 1999, becoming Chief Commercial Officer for France and a member of the Alcatel-Lucent France executive committee in 2008, then head of human resources and transformation in 2011.
She joined Schneider Electric in 2014, became chairwoman and CEO of Schneider Electric France in 2017 and executive vice president for Europe operations in 2021.

mgmt_bio.text: Christel Heydemann has been chief executive officer of the Orange Group since April 2022, having served on its board of directors since July 2017. She was appointed to the role on 28 January 2022, succeeding Stephane Richard, and took charge on 4 April 2022. In December 2024 she was appointed to the supervisory board of Canal+ as part of Vivendi's spin-off contribution.
